points: what you did after you received it

questions.text: Describe a time when someone gave you useful advice.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time when someone gave you useful advice. You should say: who gave you the advice; what the advice was; what you did after you received it; and explain why the advice was useful.

questions.text: Have you ever given the same advice to someone else?
questions.say: Thank you. Have you ever given the same advice to someone else?

questions.text: Who do young people usually go to for advice?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a time when someone gave you useful advice, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all advice. Who do young people usually go to for advice?
